zh: 把任意排列在“不上升”的位置切开，会得到若干严格递增段，上升位置数 = n − 段数。所以要让段数尽量少。
同一个值不能在同一个严格递增段里出现两次，所以段数至少是单个值的最大出现次数 F；而这个下界总能达到。
用计数数组统计每个分数的出现次数，求最大频次 F，输出 n−F。（构造方法：把每个值的各次出现分到 F 行、每行至多一次，各行排序后依次相接。）
en: Cut any arrangement at every non-increasing step to get strictly increasing segments; the number of increasing positions is n minus the number of segments, so you want as few segments as possible.
The same value cannot appear twice in one strictly increasing segment, so there are at least F segments, where F is the largest multiplicity of a single value; this lower bound can always be reached.

Count each score with an array, take the largest frequency F, and print n - F. (Construction: spread the occurrences of each value over F rows, at most one per row, sort each row and concatenate the rows.)

explanationEn:
## Approach

The answer is n minus the largest number of occurrences of a single value.

## Proof of correctness

Cut the arrangement at its non-increasing steps into strictly increasing segments; equal values cannot share a segment, so there are at least F segments, where F is the largest frequency, and at most n-F increasing positions. Distribute the occurrences of each value over F rows, at most once per row, and sort each row; a value with frequency F appears in every row, so the last item of a row is at least that value, which is at least the first item of the next row, and no increasing position appears between rows. This gives exactly n-F and attains the upper bound.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(n).
